meta.title: Translate PDF and Word Documents Online
meta.description: Translate PDF and Word (DOCX) documents between Indonesian, English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, French, German and Spanish. The layout is kept, and you can edit the translation before you download.

translator.benefitsTitle: A document translator that keeps your layout

benefits.title: Headings, tables and spacing stay in place
benefits.body: Each translated passage goes where the original was, so the translated PDF or Word file looks like the document you uploaded.

benefits.title: Edit the translation in your browser
benefits.body: Review the AI translation next to the original page, correct any sentence, and restore the AI version of a passage if you change your mind.

benefits.title: Download in the original format
benefits.body: A PDF comes back as a PDF and a Word document as a DOCX, with your edits included.

specs.label: Languages
specs.value: Indonesian, English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, French, German, Spanish — any pair

specs.label: Result
specs.value: Translated file in the original format, editable before download

steps.title: Upload the document
steps.body: Choose or drop a PDF or DOCX file of up to 5 MB.

steps.title: Choose the languages
steps.body: Pick the language the document is in and the language you need.

steps.title: Download or edit
steps.body: Download the translation as it is, or open it in the editor to correct it first.

faq.question: Can I translate a PDF from Indonesian to English?
faq.answer: Yes. Choose Indonesian as the document language and English as the target. Any pair of the eight supported languages works in both directions.

faq.question: Does the translation keep the original formatting?
faq.answer: The translator reads headings, lists and tables and puts each translated passage where the original was, so pages and spacing stay in place.

faq.question: Can I translate a scanned PDF?
faq.answer: Not yet. The translator needs a PDF with selectable text. A scanned PDF contains only images of the pages.

faq.question: Is my translated document saved?
faq.answer: Yes. The translated document is saved so you can reopen it in the editor and download it again.

meta.title: AI Document Summarizer for PDF and Word
meta.description: Summarize a PDF or Word document with AI. Get a short overview and 3, 5 or 8 key points, in the document's language or another of the eight supported languages.

summarizer.benefitsTitle: Get the point of a long document in a minute

benefits.title: An overview and the key points
benefits.body: The summary starts with a short overview, followed by the points that matter most.

benefits.title: Choose how long it is
benefits.body: Short gives 3 key points, medium 5 and detailed 8, so you can skim or go deeper.

benefits.title: Summaries in another language
benefits.body: Keep the document's language, or get the summary in Indonesian, English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, French, German or Spanish.

specs.label: Summary length
specs.value: Short (3 key points), medium (5) or detailed (8)

specs.label: Result
specs.value: Overview and key points to copy or download as text

steps.title: Upload the document
steps.body: Choose or drop a PDF or DOCX file of up to 5 MB.

steps.title: Choose the length and language
steps.body: Pick short, medium or detailed, and the language of the summary.

steps.title: Read, copy or download
steps.body: Read the overview and key points on screen, copy them, or download them as a text file.

faq.question: How long does summarizing take?
faq.answer: The AI reads the whole document, so it can take from a few seconds to a few minutes for long documents.

faq.question: What happens with very long documents?
faq.answer: If a document is very long, only its first part is summarized, and the result tells you so.

faq.question: Is my document kept after summarizing?
faq.answer: No. The summarizer returns the summary without keeping a copy of your file.

meta.title: Extract Data from PDF and Word Documents
meta.description: Pull names, organizations, dates, amounts, places, e-mail addresses, phone numbers and links out of a PDF or Word document with AI. Copy them or download CSV or JSON.

extractor.benefitsTitle: Find the details in a document without reading it all

benefits.title: Eight kinds of details
benefits.body: People, organizations, dates, amounts, places, e-mail addresses, phone numbers and links are listed separately.

benefits.title: Ready for a spreadsheet
benefits.body: Copy the results, or download them as CSV for a spreadsheet or JSON for another system.

benefits.title: Marked for checking
benefits.body: Results are marked as found by AI, so you know which important details to check against the document.

specs.label: Details found
specs.value: People, organizations, dates, amounts, places, e-mail addresses, phone numbers, links

extractor.stepsTitle: How to extract information from a document

steps.title: Upload the document
steps.body: Choose or drop a PDF or DOCX file of up to 5 MB.

steps.title: Let the AI read it
steps.body: The extractor looks for each kind of detail in the text.

steps.title: Check and export
steps.body: Review what was found, then copy it or download CSV or JSON.

faq.question: Can I extract data from an invoice or contract?
faq.answer: Yes, as long as it is a PDF with selectable text or a Word document. Dates, amounts, organizations and contact details are typical results.

faq.question: How accurate is the extraction?
faq.answer: The AI finds most details, but it can miss or misread some. Check important ones, such as amounts and dates, against the document.

faq.question: Is my document kept after extraction?
faq.answer: No. The extractor returns the results without keeping a copy of your file.

meta.title: PDF to Word and Word to PDF Converter
meta.description: Convert a PDF into an editable Word (DOCX) document, or a Word document into a PDF. Text, tables and images are rebuilt, not flattened. Files up to 10 MB.

converter.benefitsTitle: Convert PDF and Word in both directions

benefits.title: PDF to editable Word
benefits.body: Text, tables and images are rebuilt as Word content you can edit in Word, Google Docs or LibreOffice.

benefits.title: Word to PDF
benefits.body: Headings, text styles, lists, tables and images are laid out on A4 pages, ready to share or print.

benefits.title: No direction to choose
benefits.body: Upload a PDF to get Word, or a Word file to get a PDF. The converter picks the direction from your file.

specs.label: Result
specs.value: DOCX from a PDF, PDF from a DOCX

specs.label: Scanned PDFs
specs.value: Converted, with the pages as images in Word

converter.stepsTitle: How to convert PDF to Word or Word to PDF

steps.title: Upload the file
steps.body: Choose or drop a PDF or DOCX file of up to 10 MB.

steps.title: Convert
steps.body: Start the conversion. The direction follows the file type.

steps.title: Download
steps.body: Download the Word document or PDF.

faq.question: Can I edit the Word file after converting a PDF?
faq.answer: Yes. Text, tables and images come out as normal Word content, not as a picture of the page.

faq.question: What happens to a scanned PDF?
faq.answer: A scanned PDF has no selectable text, so its pages come out as images in the Word document.

faq.question: Is my file kept after converting?
faq.answer: No. The converter returns the result without keeping a copy of your file.

meta.title: Merge PDF and Split PDF Online
meta.description: Combine up to 20 PDF files into one in the order you choose, or split a PDF by page range, into single pages, or pull out selected pages.

pdf.benefitsTitle: Merge and split PDFs in one place

benefits.title: Merge in the right order
benefits.body: Add up to 20 PDFs, reorder them, and combine them into one file.

benefits.title: Split by page range
benefits.body: Enter ranges like 1-3, 5, 8-10 and get one PDF per range, or one PDF for every page.

benefits.title: Pull out or remove pages
benefits.body: Put only the pages you select into a single PDF, to extract some pages or drop others.

specs.label: Result
specs.value: One merged PDF, or split parts packed in a ZIP file

pdf.stepsTitle: How to merge or split a PDF

steps.title: Choose merge or split
steps.body: Open the Merge PDFs or Split a PDF tab.

steps.title: Add the files and options
steps.body: Add and order the PDFs to merge, or pick the pages to split.

steps.title: Download
steps.body: Download the merged PDF, or the split parts.

faq.question: How many PDFs can I merge at once?
faq.answer: Up to 20 PDF files, each up to 10 MB.

faq.question: How do I split a PDF into separate pages?
faq.answer: Choose Every page on the Split a PDF tab. Each page becomes its own PDF, packed in one ZIP file.

faq.question: Can I merge scanned PDFs?
faq.answer: Yes. Merging and splitting work on any PDF, including scanned ones.

meta.title: Resize Images Online — JPG, PNG, WEBP
meta.description: Resize JPG, PNG and WEBP images to exact pixel dimensions or presets such as 1200 × 630 for social sharing. Crop, fit inside or stretch, and pick the output format.

resizer.benefitsTitle: Resize an image to the exact size you need

benefits.title: Presets for common sizes
benefits.body: Social share (1200 × 630), square post (1080 × 1080), story (1080 × 1920), Full HD (1920 × 1080) and thumbnail (400 × 300).

benefits.title: You choose how it fits
benefits.body: Crop to fill the exact size, fit the whole image inside, or stretch it. Or keep the aspect ratio and enter only one side.

benefits.title: Change the format too
benefits.body: Keep the original format, or save the result as JPG, PNG or WEBP.

specs.label: Result
specs.value: Resized image in JPG, PNG or WEBP

steps.title: Upload the image
steps.body: Choose or drop a JPG, PNG or WEBP image of up to 10 MB.

steps.title: Set the size
steps.body: Pick a preset or enter the width and height, and choose how the image fits.

steps.title: Download
steps.body: Preview the resized image and download it.

faq.question: How do I resize an image to 1200 × 630 px?
faq.answer: Choose the Social share preset, or enter 1200 and 630. Crop fills the exact size by trimming the edges.

faq.question: Can I resize without distorting the image?
faq.answer: Yes. Keep the aspect ratio and enter a width or a height, or use Crop or Fit inside when both sides are set.

faq.question: Is my image kept after resizing?
faq.answer: No. The resizer returns the result without keeping a copy of your image.

meta.title: Compress Images Online — JPG, PNG, WEBP
meta.description: Reduce the file size of JPG, PNG and WEBP images with a quality level you control. Optionally shrink the longest side. Location and camera data are removed.

compressor.benefitsTitle: Make images small enough to upload and send

benefits.title: You control the quality
benefits.body: Slide between a smaller file and a sharper image, and see how much smaller the result is.

benefits.title: Shrink large photos
benefits.body: Set a longest side, such as 1920 px, to save the most on photos from phones and cameras.

benefits.title: Private details removed
benefits.body: Camera and location data are removed from the compressed image.

specs.label: Result
specs.value: Smaller image without camera or location data

steps.title: Upload the image
steps.body: Choose or drop a JPG, PNG or WEBP image of up to 10 MB.

steps.title: Choose the quality
steps.body: Set the quality, and optionally the longest side and the output format.

steps.title: Download
steps.body: See how much smaller the image is, then download it.

faq.question: Will compression make my image look worse?
faq.answer: At the default quality, the difference is usually not visible. Lower the quality for a smaller file.

faq.question: Why didn't my image get smaller?
faq.answer: Some images are already well compressed. Try a lower quality, the WEBP format, or a smaller longest side.

faq.question: Is my image kept after compressing?
faq.answer: No. The compressor returns the result without keeping a copy of your image.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: This page doesn't exist or has moved. Pick one of the tools below, or go back to the home page.
